item.tib: rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo'i sgrub pa'i las gzhung pha rol byad kyi brag ri 'joms pa'i thog mda'
item.coloph: ces gshen rab mchog de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug gtor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub phyir bzlog pa chen mo rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo'i rgyud las las gzhung pha rol byad kyi brag ri 'joms pa'i thog mda' 'di ni/ sems dpa' chen po mtshungs med gsang sngags grags pa khu dbon gyis snga mo nas gsung gis bskul ba dang / nye bar dad stobs kyis 'byor ba'i zhing skyongs mi yi dbang po gyur pa rnams nas nan tur gyis byung ngor/ kho bo snyoms las pa kun grol grags pas/ shar rgyal mo rgya yi rong chen du gtsug lag chen mo ngo mtshar rab bzhed gling du/ dus kyi pho nya'i zla tshes su brtsams pa rgyal bstan gsal ba'i sgron me gyur cig/
